Preserve the original table surface and clear middle. No Santa, fantasy scenery, giant decorations, repeated decorative Christmas tree, or change of location. Warm holiday lights must remain small plausible details within the existing architecture.
inspection: Inspected original and generated edit. Same canal, bridge, bicycles, house facades, friends, chairs and table. Bare snow-dusted trees, open blue canal, warm windows and small lights. Clear dry foreground; no baked vessel or text.
tableMeasurement: Visual inspection and strongest central 201-pixel row gradient at the tabletop rear edge.
